backend/main.mo: Defines types and state for users, providers, clients, jobs, and includes authorization, storage mixins, and profile helper functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report describing a logo-replacement feature and the associated frontend file and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A mapping of frontend file paths to brief summaries for reference in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and theme color variables for light and dark modes using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, role onboarding, routing, and page rendering.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper providing header, footer, and support drawer around content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: UI for selecting a user role and submitting it via mutation during onboarding.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer displaying copyright, support trigger, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with role-based navigation, mobile menu, login button, and logo rendering.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Location input component allowing manual entry or browser-based geolocation.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Displays provider details including verification, rate, category, and ratings in a clickable card.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Interactive or read-only 1–5 star rating input component.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Drawer UI showing phone and email support options with contact links.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on the Internet Identity, invalidating related queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login state, persistence, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, provider management, searches, and job actions using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes plus global base styles.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Exports service category definitions with icons and helpers for lookup and business type labeling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React root, sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, and renders the App.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Admin interface for viewing providers and updating their verification status via dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays searchable service categories and navigates users to results for a selected category.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Shows providers for a category with fallback when Google Maps isn’t configured and supports list navigation.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Lets clients view, cancel, and complete jobs while submitting ratings through a dialog.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Displays detailed info for a selected provider, shows verification status and ratings, and allows creating a job request.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Lists providers filtered by category and search query, with navigation to categories, map view, and provider detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the marketing landing page with hero content and feature highlights.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to view and update their profile details including name, rate, business type, contact info, and location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Shows the provider’s verification status and explains required documents, with upload functionality pending.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and content paths.
project_state.json: Describes the current Genz App project state, including architecture notes, required features, known issues, and branding/image requirements. Serves as a high-level roadmap outlining roles, marketplace functionality, payments, and UI/UX direction.
